Name: Wilo's Giant Greenhouse Redux
Author: Redawilo
Description:
A complete overhaul to my old [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1109]Giant Greenhouse[/url]! This new one features:
[list]
[*]No warps! You simply walk between the rooms now!
[*]40 regular 5x5 crop plots for all standard crops (including seasonal foraging)!
[*]2 irrigated 5x5 plots for rice and taro root (you can also fill your watering can here)!
[*]12 3x3 plots for tea and trellis crops to be planted around quality sprinklers so that you can-
[/list][list=1]
[*]Harvest all crops!
[*]AND still harvest 24 at a time like the regular crops!
[/list][list]
[*]Either-
[/list][list=1]
[*]An 8x6 set of single plots for all fruit trees!
[*]An 13x6 set of single plots for all fruit, oak, maple, pine, mahogany, and mushroom trees!

[/list]
Configuration is simple. In config.json simply put:
[list]
[*]"[b][u]Reg[/u][/b]" for 8x6 trees!
[*]"[b][u]XL[/u][/b]" for 13x6 trees!
[/list]

[u][b]1.1.0 Update:
[/b][/u][list]
[*]Tree room has been updated in both versions, as fruit trees could not be planted so close to each other.
Because I tried not to change room parameters too much you now can only have 6 of each tree instead of 8. Sorry.[/list]

I will [u][b]NOT[/b][/u] be making space for machines!
The OG Giant Greenhouse only had space because of a happy accident due to how I formatted the plots. Also, that mod was made LONG before sheds were implemented. If you want a lot of space for machines, I recommend picking up one of the many incredible shed mods!
